segments.oily: Some reviewers with oily or oily/combination skin report the cream absorbs well and controls shine, though one with resilient oily/combination skin reports it damaged her skin barrier.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say nothing hydrates like it and it locks in moisture, while a larger number report it leaves their face stiff, flaky, and burning as it dries down and call it unsuitable for dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally describe it as a good night moisturizer that grips well under makeup, though one with sensitive dry/combo skin found it too heavy at first.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe themselves as sensitive are divided, with several reporting no issues or even good results and others reporting rashes, redness, or allergic-type reactions.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin (50s-60s) generally report firming, plumping, and hydration benefits with no adverse reactions.
segments.normal: The few reviewers with normal skin report positive hydration and no irritation.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report smoother, firmer, plumper skin and reduced fine lines with continued use; no dissent on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration and a dewy glow, but a notable minority say the product just sits on top of skin, never absorbs, and leaves them drier than before.
concerns.redness: One reviewer's face turned bright red for hours before resolving overnight into smoother skin; another reports ongoing red, sensitive skin and irritation after use, so outcomes are inconsistent.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with oily/combination skin reports the product seriously damaged her skin barrier with lasting effects; others credit it with helping repair an overproducing, stripped barrier.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers note fading or evening of dark spots and brightening with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several acne-prone or breakout-prone users report no new breakouts and even clearer skin, while multiple others describe sudden cystic pimples, whiteheads, or rash-like breakouts, some lasting weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report it does not feel greasy and helps control shine through the day.

I've had no bad reactions to the product so far. It leaves your skin feeling very firm. If you have dry skin you should try this.

This product will now be my daily/nightly go to moisturizer! My skin and i have never been friends. And i did a lot of damage to it in the 80's and 90's when i was a teenager because we didn't have affordable products like this. The products we did have did more harm than good. And using sunscreen back then was almost unheard of. I always thought i had super oily skin so I rarely used any moisturizing products because I was always afraid of breaking out. Since I turned 50 a few months ago, I really started to pay attention to skin care and have spent A LOT of time researching products that will work for mature skin that is also oily. Once I realized that my skin looks always looks oily because I was overusing products that stripped my skin of moisture, I started to understand. My skin barrier was trying to protect itself by constantly producing oil. It was just a vicious cycle. The first time I used this jelly cream, I put on A LOT. It stayed sticky for a few hours and my skin didn't burn, but my face turned bright red for a goos while. I almost washed it off but decided that since I didn't feel a burning sensation, I would go ahead and leave it on and see what my face looked like in the morning. I couldnt believe it! extraits.titre: Got Me my First Compliment on my Skin! :)
extraits.texte: I have struggle with fungal, cystic, and regular acne since I was 11. I also kind of gave up on skin scare products around 2019 because EVERYTHING made me break out, dry out, or greasy. I took a leap and bought this because of social media, and used it every other night for now, 5 weeks. An older lady at the grocery store stopped me today to compliment my complexion and said I "looked amazing." If youre going to buy it, use it consistently and I promise itll change your skin.
